title: RBI Proposed Revamped Business Correspondent (BC) Framework
summary: RBI creates two distinct BC tiers — BC-BOs and BC-BTs — and abolishes Business Facilitators by September 30, 2026.

blocks.content: RBI issued draft guidelines introducing a two-tier Business Correspondent structure to strengthen rural financial inclusion: **BC-Banking Outlets (BC-BOs)** and **BC-Banking Touchpoints (BC-BTs)**.

items: **BC-BOs**: Fixed-location units operating min 4 hours/day, 5 days/week, offering full services (account opening, cash, KYC) with fixed + variable pay.
**BC-BTs**: Flexible-hour touchpoints for small cash/remittances paid via variable incentives.
**Abolition of BFs**: Business Facilitators category abolished; all existing BFs must transition to BC structure by Sept 30, 2026.
